learning_objective: 🎯 To discover the magic hidden in Indian kitchens and learn how common spices act as natural medicines to keep us healthy!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Our Indian kitchens are not just for cooking tasty food! They are actually mini hospitals filled with magical jars of natural medicines.
Turmeric is a bright yellow superstar. When we get hurt or have a cough, grandma's golden milk helps our bodies fight germs and heal faster.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🫚 Ginger and Clove to the Rescue
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Ginger tea is the best superhero for a bad cold or a sore throat. And if you ever have a terrible toothache, a tiny clove can magically make the pain go away!
Eating these spices daily acts like an invisible shield around us. They make our immunity strong so we do not fall sick easily.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Grandma's Secret Recipe!
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your parents or grandparents which spice they use when you have a bad cough. Write down their special magic remedy!

quick_recap: ⭐ Indian kitchens hold spices that are excellent natural remedies.
⭐ Turmeric helps heal wounds and fights off stubborn coughs.
⭐ Ginger is wonderful for digestion and soothing sore throats.
⭐ Cloves are famous for instantly stopping terrible toothaches.
